types.utc: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with up to nanosecond precision
types.path: local filesystem path; canonical absolute path in results
types.reason: optional user-written recovery rationale; max 512 bytes, no control characters

activity_contract.initialization: First successful explicit link initializes computer identity. Unlinked initial work returns untracked without creating state; bindings resolve locally by Git common-directory or nearest ordinary-directory scope.

actions.notes: Explicit project required; no picker is shipped. Missing task uses a still-active saved choice or sole active task; missing timezone uses a saved choice for this account/project. Unresolved choices return input_required. Path defaults cwd. No user override. Omitted revision means create-only or identical no-op.
ID and path mutually exclusive; defaults cwd. Exactly one binding returned or not_found.
Requires --yes; rejects attached working/waiting/stale generations. Historical snapshots persist.
Explicit locator replacement only; same attribution, --yes, no attached generation, no conflicting locator. No remote/name-based guessing.
--yes; detach/tombstone only the targeted generation. Waiting adds no time; working/stale quarantines tail for explicit recovery. Never cascades to children.
Account/project filters do not access credentials.

Exactly one end/discard_tail. Computes bounds, old confirmed prefix, excluded suffix and before/after union through the shared engine. No state or Harvest mutation. Resolve must use returned uncertainty revision; concurrent changes require fresh preview.
Exactly one of end/discard_tail; --yes. Bounds validated under lock. May finalize safe unions; no Harvest write.

activity_contract.local_mutation_semantics: request_id is a UUID; CLI generates one if omitted. Exact replay returns original typed result before config, account, credentials, network or path discovery, after a local durability check. Same request ID with changed explicit intent returns request_conflict. Retry local_write_unknown with the same request ID; safe error details include it. No Harvest writes. Recovery observations also keep receipts for no-ops; replay precedes clock sampling. A committed safety quarantine may return a persisted clock error without completing the requested interrupt/resolution; same-ID replay returns the original error. A new request is required for a new reviewed intent.
activity_contract.recovery_semantics: Review/status/preview are read-only and never access credentials. Preview union ranges include confirmed/resolved time for the affected attribution; open peers remain provisional. Resolve requires exact entity revision and explicit confirmation, preserves original evidence and records an audited end or discarded tail. Discard-tail can use persisted evidence without a working clock. Unresolved tails survive resume/finish/new generations. Explicit interrupt detaches only its generation, preserving working uncertainty; it is not a reliable source lifecycle stop. No Harvest writes.

credential_contract.unknown: exit 8; uncertain true; never retry automatically; inspect auth status and config show

exit_codes.130: Ctrl-C/SIGINT unless dispatched mutation outcome is uncertain (exit 8)
exit_codes.143: SIGTERM unless dispatched mutation outcome is uncertain (exit 8)

semantics.auth: HARVEST_TOKEN overrides macOS Keychain; --account overrides HARVEST_ACCOUNT_ID overrides config
semantics.date: YYYY-MM-DD, today or yesterday; relative dates use machine local timezone
semantics.duration: decimal hours, H:MM, or Go duration such as 1h30m; range 0..24 hours
semantics.pagination: complete arrays; errors never emit partial success
semantics.retry: GET only; never automatically replay mutations
semantics.time: HH:MM, same-day end strictly after start; split overnight entries
semantics.timer: current user, all dates; no automatic switch; preflight is not atomic

setup_contract.complete: false until all required capabilities are verified
setup_contract.finite: local readiness only; no credential or network access

streams.prompts: setup/link only when stdin and stdout are TTYs; --json or --non-interactive disables prompts
